scope: Bounded audit of currently obtainable existing sources; no exhaustive global absence claim.
pit_fail_not_asserted: No evidence proves timestamp is merely ingestion time. Missing provenance does not justify asserting PIT_FAIL; fail closed as DATA_BLOCKED.

source_inventory.mother: v13 schema contains no original corporate-event text/timing panel.

library.finding: Derived event/return artifacts are not source-text/vintage archives. Only headers read; outcome rows were not opened. Their existence cannot establish PIT source capability.

source_inventory.research: Prior orthogonal gate explicitly lacked historical bulk event panel and revision handling; no new verified original event archive resolved.

sampling.rule: Sort its 77 symbol IDs lexicographically and use zero-based positions [0,15,30,45,60,76]. Lock before event fetch. No selection by known companies, events, returns or rank.
sampling.limitation: Legacy live list is not frozen TWSE_LISTED_ELECTRONICS_PIT_DAILY universe; selected solely for multi-issuer API/schema smoke audit. Does not prove universe coverage.

fugle_probe.history_probe_caveat: Parameter names are exposed, but format/cursor semantics are undocumented in the returned spec. These failed bounded probes do not prove history is absent or that only 12 records exist. No guessed alternate encodings or retry/backfill engineering pursued.

capability_matrix.default_limit: All six defaults return 12; fixed cap suspected, not proven
capability_matrix.universe_coverage: UNKNOWN; 6/6 sampled issuers nonempty, not population coverage
capability_matrix.event_counts: 12 returned per sampled issuer; total historical counts unknown
capability_matrix.timestamp_field: Present second-resolution string without timezone offset
capability_matrix.first_public_availability: 72/72 timestamp strings agree with spoke_date/spoke_time in returned MOPS URL; internal consistency only, not independent proof of first availability
capability_matrix.source_url_event_id: 72 distinct IDs and URLs; two target-ID probes retain matching event. Long-term stability/versioning unproven
capability_matrix.correction: Standalone correction and supplement announcements observed; no structured supersedes/version/withdrawal chain in row schema
capability_matrix.duplicates: No duplicate IDs/URLs in 72-row default sample; cross-publication duplicate semantics unknown
capability_matrix.original_text: title + descs field labels/content returned; text as fetched preserved in evidence snapshot, original historical versions not proven
capability_matrix.batch_retrieval: Mechanical per-symbol calls possible; historical pagination/completeness and population retrieval not proven

pit_details.availability_before_signal: Required but not established for historical original payloads
pit_details.intraday_after_close: Timestamp strings can distinguish clock times; verified timezone, first-public semantics and a frozen decision cutoff/session rule still absent. No signal_date generated.
pit_details.weekend_holiday: Need verified publication time plus official session calendar and predefined cutoff mapping; none inferred from calendar dates or shifted to midnight.
pit_details.correction_handling: Would require immutable original plus later correction linked at its own availability time; a later correction must not overwrite earlier state.
pit_details.duplicate_handling: Would require stable identity and deterministic duplicate policy; not implemented or deemed proven.
pit_details.later_edited_text: Historical original text reconstruction cannot be established from current API snapshot.

taxonomy_feasibility.assessment: Some source templates support deterministic literal field checks in principle. Full scalable taxonomy is not demonstrated and is not admitted as PASS.
taxonomy_feasibility.example: Asset acquisition/disposal announcements expose asset nature, transaction amount, purpose, counterpart and prior-announcement fields. A capex-purpose acquisition may overlap acquisition and capacity expansion, so category uniqueness is not inherent.
taxonomy_feasibility.possible_fail_closed_design_only: For a future separate contract, accept exactly one fully satisfied structural template; zero or multiple matches => EXCLUDE. No precedence learned from outcomes. This audit does not freeze a category set or create signals.
excluded_from_IF10_novelty: Guidance/expectation-revision content already scoped in IF08
Accounting-quality/financial-level changes already scoped in IF07
Attention/disposition disclosures triggered by price/volume behavior
taxonomy_feasibility.manual_scalability: Not demonstrated that every category requires subjective labor, so TAXONOMY_NOT_MECHANICALLY_SCALABLE is not asserted as fact. Historical source/PIT blockers stop work before classifier engineering.

novelty.conceptual: Corporate-event content/type/timing can be a distinct primitive; this conceptual distinction does not establish current gate PASS or statistical orthogonality.
